decode.malformedPolicy: reject before timing with typed reason

orientation.policy: read EXIF orientation before pixel transforms; apply values 1 through 8; missing orientation is 1; reject malformed or duplicate conflicting orientation metadata
orientation.selectedFixtureObservation: all six selected PNG files contain no EXIF orientation and therefore execute the identity orientation branch
orientation.testRequirement: all eight orientations and malformed metadata require synthetic unit fixtures outside the timed corpus

color.working: linear-light float32 straight RGBA converted to premultiplied RGBA before filtering
color.alpha: filter premultiplied color and alpha; unpremultiply after sharpen; RGB is zero when alpha is zero
color.metadata: strip EXIF, GPS and XMP; output declares sRGB; no source ICC profile is retained

resize.target: long edge exactly 1280 pixels, including upscaling
resize.kernel: sinc(pi*x) * sinc(pi*x/3) for |x| < 3; 1 at x=0; 0 otherwise
resize.downsampleSupport: kernel argument and amplitude scaled by min(scale,1); support radius 3/min(scale,1)
resize.normalization: normalize weights per destination sample in float64, then convert each weight to float32
resize.accumulation: left-to-right float32 multiply-add without contraction; horizontal pass then vertical pass

sharpen.name: fixed 3x3 unsharp mask
sharpen.channels: premultiplied linear RGB only; alpha passes through unchanged

webp.format: lossy VP8 in WebP RIFF container

oracle.scope: decode every produced WebP and compare every output pixel; no sampling
structural: RIFF and VP8 chunks parse without trailing or overlapping chunks
decoded alpha is 255 for every selected opaque fixture pixel
EXIF, GPS and XMP are absent
one WebP output is present for every input

perTargetAgainstPreEncodeReference.luma: BT.709 coefficients over decoded sRGB bytes

oracle.acceptanceState: thresholds are frozen but unvalidated because no controlled engine pair exists; do not time or count coverage

counters.rule: Every counter is incremented at the physical operation in both targets and is checked against a separately derived reference before timing. Missing counters remain unavailable, never zero.

lifecycle.cancel: terminate exact worker and reject its token
lifecycle.staleToken: ignored and observed in retained browser evidence
